item.title: Parking Apps and Rent Seeking
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
Photo by Joshua Santos, Pexels

I’m not an economist, but I’ve read enough Adam Smith to know he wasn’t a fan of rent‑seeking behaviour. The complication is that “rent” in economics isn’t quite the same as the rent I pay on a flat. Rather than tie myself in knots defining terms, I’ll set out what I mean through something concrete: the app my council uses for car parking.
